acceptance_signals: Before any execution or repository write after admission, a separate human task take-up captures one immutable task-start scope baseline and all three pre-existing untracked paths remain excluded and byte-identical.

Read-only preflight verifies exact current source identity, distribution manifest consistency, supported Python 3.12, offline build tooling, Codex availability, repository and user-state boundaries, zero fixture remotes before the turn, and no task-owned temporary residue.
Exactly one exact-current-source wheel is built without network or dependency download and installed into one fresh task-owned runtime before the consumer journey.
One new non-sensitive synthetic repository has exactly one local fixture baseline commit, no remote, and one deterministic README-only request.
Exactly one external Codex session receives one ordinary low-risk request without AgentGov names, internal protocol details, lifecycle commands, coaching, retry, or magic confirmation text.

Evidence distinguishes every lifecycle stage actually reached and stops at the first deviation without manufacturing proposal, human decision, take-up, edit, validation, completion, self-review, Monitor, or handoff results.
Any native human form is decided only by the human product owner; the Agent never infers, bypasses, or supplies that decision.

After privacy-bounded evidence is durable, only exact verified task-owned temporary assets are removed; pre-existing user files, configuration, credentials, trust state, processes, and repository paths remain unchanged.
The experiment record, current status, and dated log agree on outcome, first deviation, validation states, limits, denied authority, and next product review.
All declared focused, full-suite, task-governance, repository-governance, scope-baseline, JSON, and whitespace checks pass unless the first deviation explicitly prevents completion verification.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-d8a070579b444e4cae5d17bf674b57f5 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Run exactly one bounded end-to-end automatic governance rehearsal from exact current source in a new non-sensitive remote-free synthetic repository. Use the available supported Python 3.12 runtime for one offline build and isolated install, then start one ordinary low-risk Codex request without AgentGov names, protocol coaching, or magic confirmation text. Observe the actual proposal, human admission if offered, separate task take-up, edit, validation, completion recording, current-Agent review, Monitor visibility, and handoff. Stop at the first reproducibility, scope, privacy, host, protocol, or state-preservation deviation without retry or repair; retain only normalized evidence and remove only exact task-owned temporary assets when safely authorized by evidence.

items: The single external Codex session uses the existing authenticated entitlement and may consume usage before the first deviation.
A native admission form may be unavailable in the external client or may require a visible human decision; the run stops rather than bypassing it.
Exact-current-source offline build and isolated installation may fail under Python 3.12 even though it satisfies the documented minimum version.
The experiment creates a temporary synthetic Git repository with one local baseline commit; it has no remote and grants no Git authority over this repository or any real consumer.
Temporary cleanup is destructive only for exact task-owned roots after identity and evidence gates pass; otherwise recovery state remains untouched.
One rehearsal cannot establish adoption, repeatability, production reliability, causal benefit, time savings, or return on investment.
Reviewed assumption: The available Python 3.12 runtime and its existing build tooling can build current source without network access.
Reviewed assumption: The current distribution manifest remains internally consistent at execution preflight.
Reviewed assumption: The installed Codex client can start one bounded session against a temporary repository.
Reviewed assumption: A README-only synthetic change is low risk and deterministically testable.
Reviewed assumption: The human product owner is available if the external journey presents a native task-admission decision.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the exact current source builds and installs successfully under the available Python 3.12 toolchain.
Reviewed unknown: Whether one uncoached ordinary request independently selects the governance tools.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the external client negotiates and displays native proposal review.
Reviewed unknown: Which lifecycle stage the single session reaches before success or first deviation.
